simple.prompt: The annual financial report ___ by an independent auditing agency every January.
simple.explanation: Laporan keuangan adalah objek yang menerima aksi peninjauan (pasif rutin). Rumus Present Simple Passive: to be (is) + past participle (reviewed).
hints: Laporan tidak memeriksa sendiri, melainkan diperiksa.

simple.prompt: This historic suspension bridge ___ in 1883 by a visionary structural engineer.
simple.explanation: Tahun 1883 adalah waktu lampau spesifik. Rumus Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3: 'was constructed'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif sederhana dengan pelaku aksi (agent 'by').
simple.targetSentence: The email was sent by the director.
simple.explanation: Patient Subject (The email) + was + V3 (sent) + agent phrase (by the director).
hints: Pelaku aksi ditandai dengan 'by the director'.

simple.prompt: Thousands of hybrid vehicles ___ at this regional manufacturing plant every month.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'Thousands of hybrid vehicles' berpasangan dengan to be jamak 'are' + V3 'assembled'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif negatif masa lampau.
simple.targetSentence: The confidential documents were not leaked.
simple.explanation: Subject (The confidential documents) + were not + V3 (leaked).

simple.prompt: ___ the database backup created before the power outage occurred?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan pasif lampau: Was/Were + Subject + V3: 'Was the database backup created...?'

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya pasif Present Simple.
simple.targetSentence: Is English spoken in this hotel?
simple.explanation: Is + Subject (English) + V3 (spoken) + in this hotel?

simple.prompt: All glass bottles ___ collected for recycling every Wednesday morning.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'All glass bottles' dikenai tindakan rutin (Present Simple Passive): 'are + V3 (collected)'.
hints: Botol-botol tidak mengumpulkan dirinya sendiri (kalimat pasif).

simple.prompt: The historic railway bridge ___ built in 1924 by local stonemasons.
simple.explanation: Kejadian di masa lalu ('in 1924') untuk subjek tunggal ('The historic railway bridge') memakai Past Simple Passive: 'was built'.
hints: Ada tahun lampau 'in 1924' dan jembatan itu tunggal.

simple.prompt: This bilingual user guide was translated ___ our Jakarta localization team.
simple.explanation: Untuk memperkenalkan pelaku manusia/agen tindakan dalam kalimat pasif, gunakan preposisi 'by'.
hints: Pelakunya adalah tim manusia ('our Jakarta localization team').

simple.prompt: Customer credit card numbers ___ stored on our local test servers.
simple.explanation: Kalimat pasif Present Simple negatif dengan subjek jamak 'numbers' memakai 'are not + V3 (stored)'.
hints: Negatif pasif memakai 'be + not + V3', bukan 'do not'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan di meja resepsionis dengan pertanyaan pasif.
dialogue: Guest
Where ___ the lost luggage items kept at this station?
Clerk
Right behind the customer desk in Locker B.
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan pasif Present Simple untuk subjek jamak ('the lost luggage items') memakai to be 'are' sebelum subjek + V3 'kept'.
hints: Perhatikan V3 'kept' di akhir frasa subjek.

simple.prompt: Our weekly newsletter is ___ every Friday at nine sharp.
simple.explanation: Sesudah 'is' pada kalimat pasif, kata kerja selalu berbentuk Past Participle (V3): 'published'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk verb pasif pada kalimat laporan berikut.
simple.draft: Three new solar panels were install on the warehouse roof yesterday.
options: Three new solar panels were installed on the warehouse roof yesterday.
Three new solar panels were installing on the warehouse roof yesterday.
Three new solar panels did installed on the warehouse roof yesterday.
simple.explanation: Rumus Past Simple Passive adalah 'was/were + V3', sehingga 'install' harus diubah menjadi 'installed'.
hints: Panel surya dipasang (pasif), bukan memasang sendiri.

simple.prompt: Was the emergency exit door ___ before the inspector arrived?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Past Simple Passive ('Was + Subject + V3...?') memerlukan bentuk V3 'unlocked'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif Present Simple tentang aturan keamanan.
simple.targetSentence: Visitor badges are checked at the main security gate.
simple.explanation: Subject (Visitor badges) + are + V3 (checked) + place phrase.
hints: Tambahkan tempat 'at the main security gate'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif Past Simple lengkap dengan agen 'by'.
simple.targetSentence: The prototype was tested by two senior engineers last week.
simple.explanation: Subject + was + V3 + by + agent + time.
hints: Akhiri dengan 'by two senior engineers last week'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog status perbaikan peralatan kantor.
dialogue: Manager
Can we print the conference materials right now?
Assistant
Not yet. The main photocopier ___ by a technician at the moment.
intermediate.explanation: Aksi pasif yang sedang berlangsung saat ini (Present Continuous Passive) menggunakan rumus: am/is/are + BEING + V3: 'is being repaired'.
hints: Perbaikan sedang berlangsung sekarang (at the moment).

intermediate.prompt: All the meeting rooms ___ before the international delegates arrived.
intermediate.explanation: Aksi pasif yang tuntas LEBIH DULU sebelum peristiwa lampau lain (Past Perfect Passive): had been + V3: 'had been sanitized'.
hints: Aksi pasif yang terjadi lebih awal di masa lalu.
Gunakan Past Perfect Passive 'had been sanitized'.

intermediate.prompt: The new enterprise software ___ by over five hundred clients so far.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect Passive untuk subjek tunggal 'software' dengan penanda waktu 'so far': has been + V3: 'has been adopted'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif dengan modal auxiliary 'must be'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Safety goggles must be worn in the laboratory.
intermediate.explanation: Subject + modal (must) + be + V3 (worn) + prepositional phrase.
hints: Rumus modal pasif: must be + V3 (worn).

intermediate.prompt: The contract ___ signed tomorrow morning during the formal ceremony.
intermediate.explanation: Future Simple Passive: will be + V3: 'will be signed tomorrow morning'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif Continuous masa lampau.
intermediate.targetSentence: The bridge was being renovated when the accident happened.
intermediate.explanation: Subject (The bridge) + was being + V3 (renovated) + when-clause.
hints: Aktivitas pasif sedang berlangsung di masa lalu.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih alasan penghilangan pelaku aksi (omitting the agent) yang tepat.
dialogue: Auditor
Why isn't the specific suspect mentioned in the report?
Investigator
Because the perpetrator is still unknown, so the crime ___ by persons unknown.
intermediate.explanation: Pasif sangat berguna ketika pelaku aksi tidak diketahui, tidak penting, atau sudah jelas dari konteks: 'was committed'.

intermediate.prompt: Look through the glass window — the conference floor ___ mopped right now.
intermediate.explanation: Tindakan pasif yang sedang berlangsung tepat saat ini ('right now') memakai Present Continuous Passive: 'is being + V3'.
hints: Ada kata 'right now' untuk aksi pasif yang sedang berjalan.
Rumus Continuous Passive adalah 'is/are + being + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Every safety recommendation ___ already been reviewed by the compliance lead.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect Passive menggunakan rumus 'have/has + been + V3'; subjek tunggal 'Every safety recommendation' memakai 'has'.
hints: Sudah ada 'been reviewed' di belakang rumpang.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang aturan pengiriman dengan Modal Passive.
dialogue: Clerk
When must fragile parcels be packed?
Supervisor
They ___ in double-walled cardboard boxes before courier pickup.
intermediate.explanation: Pola Modal Passive selalu: Modal + 'be' + V3 ('must be packed').

intermediate.prompt: The new library annex ___ opened by the mayor next month.
intermediate.explanation: Future Simple Passive memakai rumus 'will be + V3' ('will be opened').

intermediate.prompt: Why does news reporting often omit the 'by...' agent in 'Two vintage bicycles were stolen outside the museum'?
options: Because the perpetrator is unknown or unimportant to the main focus
Because Past Simple Passive never allows 'by'
intermediate.explanation: Kalimat pasif sangat berguna ketika pelaku tindakan tidak diketahui ('unknown') atau fokus utama kalimat adalah benda/korban yang terkena aksi.
hints: Jika pelaku tidak diketahui, frasa 'by someone' dihilangkan.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum mengubah intransitive verb menjadi kalimat pasif berikut.
intermediate.draft: The afternoon parcel was arrived safely at the regional depot at three.
options: The afternoon parcel arrived safely at the regional depot at three.
The afternoon parcel had been arrived safely at the regional depot at three.
The afternoon parcel is arrived safely at the regional depot at three.
intermediate.explanation: Verb intransitif tanpa objek seperti 'arrive', 'happen', 'occur', dan 'appear' TIDAK PERNAH bisa dibuat menjadi bentuk pasif; gunakan bentuk aktif 'arrived'.
hints: Bisakah kata 'arrive' memiliki objek langsung? Tidak bisa.

intermediate.prompt: While the rooftop solar array ___ calibrated, the office switched temporarily to grid power.
intermediate.explanation: Tindakan pasif yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu berbarengan dengan aksi lain memakai Past Continuous Passive: 'was being + V3'.
hints: Aksi kalibrasi sedang berjalan saat kantor beralih ke listrik PLN.
Past Continuous Passive memakai 'was being + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: All sensitive payroll spreadsheets should ___ encrypted before uploading.
intermediate.explanation: Setelah modal 'should', wajib diikuti bentuk dasar 'be' sebelum V3 'encrypted'.
hints: Jangan memakai 'been' atau 'being' langsung setelah modal.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Present Perfect Passive dengan benar.
intermediate.targetSentence: The outdated software patches have already been removed from the server.
intermediate.explanation: Subject jamak + have already been + V3 ('removed') + keterangan tempat.
hints: Awali dengan 'The outdated software patches have already'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif Future menggunakan 'will be'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Final exam scores will be posted on the student portal tomorrow.
intermediate.explanation: Subject + will be + V3 ('posted') + place + time.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Final exam scores will be posted'.
Tambahkan tempat dan waktu di akhir.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan membuat pasif pada intransitive verb (kata kerja yang tidak memiliki objek penderita).
complex.draft: The fatal road accident was occurred around 2:00 a.m. on the coastal expressway.
options: The fatal road accident occurred around 2:00 a.m. on the coastal expressway.
The fatal road accident was occurring around 2:00 a.m. on the coastal expressway.
The fatal road accident had been occurred around 2:00 a.m. on the coastal expressway.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja intransitif seperti 'occur', 'happen', 'arrive', 'die', 'vanish' TIDAK memiliki objek penderita, sehingga SECARA MUTLAK TIDAK BISA DIBUAT PASIF (*was occurred adalah salah). Wajib aktif: 'occurred'.
hints: 'Occur' adalah kata kerja intransitif tanpa objek.

complex.prompt: When a verb has two objects (Direct and Indirect), which passive version is generally more natural in English?
options: I was offered a promotion by the board. (Indirect object becomes subject)
A promotion was offered to me by the board. (Direct object becomes subject)
Both are fully grammatical, with the person-subject version being more frequent in spoken English
complex.explanation: Kedua bentuk pasif adalah sah secara gramatikal, namun menjadikan orang (Indirect Object) sebagai subjek pasif ('I was offered a promotion') lebih alami dan umum digunakan dalam percakapan sehari-hari.
hints: Dua objek menghasilkan dua kemungkinan kalimat pasif yang sah.

complex.prompt: Prepositional passive (phrasal verb in passive): 'The community members feel that their urgent concerns were ___ by local authorities.'
complex.explanation: Pada phrasal verb pasif, preposisi bawaan (seperti 'at' pada 'laugh at') WAJIB tetap dipertahankan menempel setelah V3: 'were laughed at by...'.
hints: Preposisi dari phrasal verb tidak boleh dibuang.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif formal dengan phrasal verb 'look into'.
complex.targetSentence: The incident is being looked into by the security board.
complex.explanation: Subject + is being + V3 (looked into) + agent (by the security board). Preposisi 'into' wajib dipertahankan.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The incident is being looked into'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan pembentukan pasif pada kata kerja 'make' dalam bentuk aktif vs pasif.
complex.draft: During the military drills, the new recruits were made perform two hundred push-ups.
options: During the military drills, the new recruits were made to perform two hundred push-ups.
During the military drills, the new recruits were made performing two hundred push-ups.
During the military drills, the new recruits made to perform two hundred push-ups.
complex.explanation: Dalam kalimat aktif, 'make' diikuti bare infinitive ('They made him perform'). Namun ketika diubah ke PASIF, partikel 'to' WAJIB dimunculkan kembali: 'were made TO perform'.
hints: Dalam bentuk pasif, 'be made' wajib diikuti 'to + infinitive'.

complex.prompt: The identity of the confidential whistleblower ___ under any circumstances.
complex.explanation: Modal pasif negatif: modal (must) + not + be + V3 (disclosed): 'must not be disclosed'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog hukum formal mengenai asas praduga tak bersalah.
dialogue: Judge
What is the core principle of constitutional due process?
Defense Attorney
Every accused citizen is presumed innocent until guilt ___ beyond reasonable doubt.
complex.explanation: Klausa waktu 'until...' menggunakan Present Simple Passive: 'until guilt is proven'.

complex.prompt: With a two-object verb like 'award', choose the most natural passive focused on the recipient: 'The research grant ___ to Dr. Maya' vs 'Dr. Maya ___ the research grant.'
complex.explanation: Kedua bentuk pasif berterima untuk verb dua-objek ('give', 'send', 'award'): benda sebagai subjek memakai 'to + penerima' ('was awarded to Dr. Maya'), atau penerima langsung menjadi subjek ('Dr. Maya was awarded the research grant').
hints: Cermati perbedaan konstruksi dua objek pasif.

complex.prompt: Notice the phrasal verb rule in passive voice: 'Our budget proposal must not ___ lightly by the board.'
complex.explanation: Saat phrasal verb transitif ('turn down', 'look into', 'call off') diubah ke bentuk pasif, partikelnya ('down', 'into', 'off') WAJIB tetap menempel setelah V3!
hints: Jangan buang partikel 'down' dari frasa 'turn down'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan hilangnya preposisi saat mempasifkan prepositional verb berikut.
complex.draft: Those urgent compliance warnings should never be laughed or ignored.
options: Those urgent compliance warnings should never be laughed at or ignored.
Those urgent compliance warnings should never be laughed about to or ignored.
Those urgent compliance warnings should never laugh at or ignore.
complex.explanation: Verb berpreposisi seperti 'laugh at' atau 'rely on' harus mempertahankan preposisinya ('laughed at') saat diubah ke pasif agar tidak hilang makna dan keselarasan sintaksis.
hints: Dalam pasif, 'at' wajib ikut menempel setelah 'laughed'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang perbaikan barang memakai Causative Passive ('have/get something done').
dialogue: Manager
Did you repair the broken reception lock yourself?
Assistant
No, I had no time, so I ___ by the building locksmith yesterday.
complex.explanation: Pola Causative Passive bermakna 'menyuruh orang lain mengerjakan sesuatu untuk kita' adalah: 'have/get + Object (it) + V3 (replaced)'.
hints: Urutan causative pasif: have/get + benda + V3.

complex.prompt: Before the bridge reopens, its steel cables need ___ thoroughly inspected by marine engineers.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'need', bentuk pasif baku adalah 'need to be + V3' (atau dalam ragam aktif-bentuk V-ing 'need inspecting', bukan 'to been').
hints: 'Need' dapat diikuti pasif infinitive 'to be + V3'.

complex.prompt: By the time the inspector arrived, all temporary scaffolding ___ already been dismantled.
complex.explanation: Kejadian pasif yang tuntas SEBELUM satu kejadian lampau lain ('arrived') menggunakan Past Perfect Passive: 'had + been + V3'.
hints: Past Perfect Passive memakai 'had already been + V3'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menggunakan kata kerja aktif intransitif 'occur' dalam bentuk pasif berikut.
complex.draft: The sudden pressure drop was occurred right after valve B closed.
options: The sudden pressure drop occurred right after valve B closed.
The sudden pressure drop was occurring right after valve B closed always.
The sudden pressure drop has been occurred right after valve B closed.
complex.explanation: 'Occur', 'happen', 'take place', dan 'exist' adalah verb intransitif sejati yang TIDAK punya bentuk pasif; ubah menjadi bentuk aktif 'occurred'.
hints: Hapus 'was' agar menjadi Past Simple aktif 'occurred'.

complex.prompt: We are getting our laboratory air vents ___ next weekend before the inspection.
complex.explanation: Dengan 'getting + Object (air vents) + ...', konstruksi Causative Passive selalu memakai Past Participle (V3): 'cleaned'.
hints: Air vents mengalami aksi pembersihan, bukan membersihkan.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif dengan prepositional verb 'look into'.
complex.targetSentence: Every customer complaint is carefully looked into by the quality desk.
complex.explanation: Partikel 'into' wajib dipertahankan tepat setelah 'looked' meskipun diikuti frasa agen 'by...'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Every customer complaint is carefully'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat Causative Passive menggunakan 'have + object + V3'.
complex.targetSentence: The company had all delivery vans serviced before the holiday rush.
complex.explanation: Subjek 'The company' menyuruh mekanik menyervis mobil: had + all delivery vans + serviced.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The company had all delivery vans'.
